def es_anagrama(a, b):
    # Normalizar: pasar a minúsculas y eliminar espacios
    a_norm = ''.join(a.lower().split())
    b_norm = ''.join(b.lower().split())
    # Comparar contadores de caracteres
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(a_norm) == Counter(b_norm)

def es_anagrama(a, b):
    # Normalizar: eliminar espacios y pasar a minúsculas
    a_clean = a.replace(" ", "").lower()
    b_clean = b.replace(" ", "").lower()
    # Comparar contadores de caracteres
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(a_clean) == Counter(b_clean)
